title: Hand off a 200 kg electrode roll to a powered expanding chuck
context: Production roll changeovers use powered core-handling equipment. This full-size handoff tests alignment, distributed core gripping and retention under the actual 1.96 kN gravity load before a donor shaft is withdrawn.
instruction: Transfer the full 200 kg electrode roll from the donor shaft to the powered receiving chuck. Align and insert the receiver, expand its core grip, then withdraw the donor. Lift and move the supported roll to y=350 mm, axis height 1080 mm. Stop the carriage and pass the two-second retention test under 25 N m torque and 300 N axial pull. Do not drop the roll or rely on the donor during the test.
setup: SI coordinates: X is the horizontal core axis and Z is up. Dry wound electrode roll: 600 mm outside diameter, 370 mm width, 76.2 mm nominal aluminium-core bore, 200 kg, centre (0,0,1.000) m. A red angular witness marks one sector. The rigid composite annulus has 48 sectors; minimum inscribed bore is 76.04 mm. Donor steel shaft assembly: 45 kg, 560 mm long, 75.8 mm diameter, axis z=1 m, nose x=-40 mm, 400 mm withdrawal stroke; a 150 kg fixed support has its origin (-0.600,0,0.600) m. Receiver fixed steel support origin (0.660,0,0.600) m: 150 kg base, two 20 kg carriages and 35 kg head assembly. Its 400 mm long, 56 mm diameter shaft initially has nose x=260 mm, y=12 mm, z=985 mm. Three 0.5 kg steel jaw assemblies have 150 x 12 x 16 mm lugs, equally spaced around the bore, with 9 mm radial travel. Their centres are 315 mm behind the head frame; collapsed outer radius is 31 mm. XYZ axes have X/Y 10 kN and Z 6 kN effort limits; each jaw is limited to 4 kN. Donor drive limit is 6 kN. The controller caps speeds to 40/60/25 mm/s for XYZ, 4 mm/s for jaws and 60 mm/s for donor. Ideal encoders, three calibrated pad normal-contact-force gauges and a donor normal-support gauge are part of the fixture. A marked destination is y=350 mm, roll axis z=1080 mm. The grounded, guarded machine uses native joints and contacts; there are no manual lifting arms. Each open 150 kg frame has two 80 x 60 x 1200 mm hollow-steel posts at local y=+/-370 mm; an 80 x 800 x 80 mm crossbeam at local z=560 mm; and a 320 x 800 x 80 mm foot at local z=-560 mm. The receiver X carriage has a 100 x 800 x 80 mm rail; its Y carriage has an 80 x 100 x 500 mm mast centred 250 mm below the carriage frame. Expand=1 commands 8.9 mm jaw extension, just inside the 9 mm mechanical stroke; native contact and the 4 kN limit determine actual travel. The fixed grey floor is 4 x 4 x 0.1 m, top at z=0; a green 420 x 20 x 4 mm destination strip is centred at (0,0.350,0.003) m. Two fixed 640 x 360 RGB cameras show an overview and a core close-up.
scoring: Score 0 for nonfinite data, an ejected roll (|x|>=250 mm or |y|>=600 mm), or a drop (centre z<700 mm); invalid state latches zero until reset. Insertion requires >=140 mm finite axial overlap, roll axis within 2 degrees of X and core centre within 4 mm of the receiver axis. 0.25: insertion with donor still extended and measured donor support >=1000 N; roll speed <10 mm/s and <0.15 rad/s. Clamped means insertion plus each measured jaw extension >=5.5 mm and each actual pad normal-contact-force magnitude >=500 N. Donor clear means withdrawal >=350 mm and measured donor contact <10 N. 0.5: clamped, donor clear, roll centre z>=1045 mm and the same stillness limits. 1.0: clamped and donor clear at destination (|x|<=5 mm, y=350+/-5 mm, z=1080+/-5 mm), with the 25 N m axial torque and 300 N axial pull physically applied for 2 continuous seconds. Throughout this interval, position changes <=3 mm and orientation changes <=3 degrees from the start. The test must be requested; a failed interval is restarted by releasing its request. Intermediate outcomes receive the highest satisfied partial tier. Final score is used. Physical checks use encoders/gauges, a ruler and angular witness, and a calibrated 25 Nm/300 N test fixture.
run_limit: 30 LLM calls and at most 2,400 control steps (120 simulation seconds at 20 Hz)
reset_notes: Restore the roll and both shaft assemblies to their specified poses, collapse the receiver jaws, extend the donor and clear the proof/drop history. Physical trials require rated, guarded industrial handling equipment and qualified operators; drop variants are simulation-only.
fidelity: Full-size 200 kg rigid annulus and open core; force-limited powered axes and three expanding jaws use native PhysX contact. Normal-force gauges plus an applied 25 Nm/300 N test verify retention. Ideal encoders. Wound-layer slip, core crushing and coating damage are excluded. Hollow-frame interiors are simplified. Original MIT USD assets; no roll attachments or pose teleports.
scores: Not yet evaluated. Physics demo and genuine LLM trial must be completed before submission.
